A step that fails after its approval is consumed but before its effect starts is labelled unknown rather than abandoned (a label only; nothing is retried). Reconciliation reads the target at start and can be raced by a writer between the check and the hash (a label only). The verification text names the destination path and the approved SHA-256. Process, clipboard and desktop effects are journaled with the opaque postcondition and are never probed: an interrupted one is always unknown and needs re-observation.
